objective: Converge production cognitive orchestration behind ContextFabric while retaining RLM as the implementation substrate.

rulesConsidered: ContextFabric is the sole production context entry facade.
RLM/ContextOrchestrator is an implementation substrate, not active-context authority.
Cognitive runtime context operations must route through ContextFabric.
No new database or authority is introduced.
Every non-trivial change follows the Team Change Gate.

changes: Added a narrow ContextFabric orchestration port.
Bound ContextOrchestrator to ContextFabric from CognitivePlaneEngine.
Routed CognitiveRuntime context indexing through ContextFabric.
Routed CognitiveRuntime recursive investigation through ContextFabric.
Extended the production boundary verifier to reject direct contextOrchestrator member access outside canonical wiring/substrate files.
Added focused delegation tests and reconciled .okf evidence.

verificationResults.note: Fresh exact-head validation is required before merge. No CLM inference/training or ContextBench work is included.

model.name: Ascalon / ShortForge Cognitive Model
model.role: design/review context only; no runtime authority and no training activity
